The code contains two separate issues causing `flake8` errors in Python 3.

1. In `ambassador/ambassador_diag/envoy.py`, the `EnvoyStats.update_envoy_stats` method references an undefined variable `active_cluster_map` on line 235. This variable was part of a commented-out block (lines 222-227). Because of the logic `if True or (cluster_name in active_cluster_map):`, the code currently bypasses the check via the `True` condition, but the interpreter will still fail if it attempts to evaluate the right side of the `or` if the left side were false (or simply because the name is unbound in the scope). To fix this, the `if True or ...` condition should be simplified to `if True:` or the logic should be cleaned up to remove the reference to the non-existent variable.

2. In `scripts/versioner.py`, the code uses `unicode(self)` on line 103. In Python 3, `unicode` was renamed to `str`. To ensure compatibility with Python 3, `unicode(self)` must be changed to `str(self)`.

**Summary of changes:**
- `ambassador/ambassador_diag/envoy.py`: Remove the reference to `active_cluster_map` in `EnvoyStats.update_envoy_stats` (line 235).
- `scripts/versioner.py`: Replace `unicode(self)` with `str(self)` (line 103).
